standard-dialogue-after-tree-gnome-villa.text: If the player lost the gnome amulet:

steps.npc: Here, I think this belongs to you.

steps.text: King Bolren gives you an amulet.

standard-dialogue-after-tree-gnome-villa.npc: Hello there. It's good to see you again.
Those Khazard troops continue to be a menace, but things are much better now. All thanks to you, of course.

standard-dialogue-after-tree-gnome-villa.text: You do not meet all of the requirements to start The Path of Glouphrie quest.
If the player has lost their gnome amulet:

steps.npc: Here, I think this belongs to you.

steps.text: King Bolren gives you an amulet.

standard-dialogue-after-tree-gnome-villa.npc: Hello there. Any luck in the quest for Arposandra?

standard-dialogue-after-tree-gnome-villa.player: Sort of. I think I've worked out where Arposandra is, but my attempt to enter didn't go well. There seems to be quite an extensive set of defences.

standard-dialogue-after-tree-gnome-villa.npc: Ah, that is a problem. I wish I could offer more help, but the Khazard Army already poses a major threat to us. We can't afford to split ourselves fighting two different enemies.
For now, I'm afraid so. Glouphrie is a foe that must be dealt with one day, but that day is not today.

standard-dialogue-after-tree-gnome-villa.text: If the player has lost their gnome amulet:

steps.npc: Here, I think this belongs to you.

steps.text: King Bolren gives you an amulet.

standard-dialogue-after-tree-gnome-villa.npc: I fear the war against the Khazard Army is set to outlive us all. We keep making progress, but for every foe we defeat, Khazard sends two more.
Still, we thankfully haven't had any more Glouphrie problems at least.

standard-dialogue-after-tree-gnome-villa.player: That's good to hear. All the best.

steps.text: The king has given you another clue scroll!

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player doesn't have the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has a premade item in their inventory:

steps.text: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over your delivery of [item] to King Bolren

steps.npc: Thank you. I don't have any gnome cooks here. I should really do something about that.
You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.

steps.text: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
If the player does not have a reward token available:
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
If the player does have a reward token available:
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
If the player has an unclaimed reward token:
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
If the player has claimed their reward token:

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player ran out of time:

steps.text: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
